import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int LIMIT = 10;
    static char[][] world = new char[LIMIT][LIMIT];
    static int[][] pop = new int[LIMIT][LIMIT];
    static int[][] help = new int[LIMIT][LIMIT];
    static int[][] fire = new int[LIMIT][LIMIT];
    static int[][][][] time_to_reach = new int[LIMIT][LIMIT][LIMIT][LIMIT];
    
    static final int[] dx = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    
    static final int TOTAL_NODES = 2 * LIMIT * LIMIT + 2;
    static final int MAX_VAL = 1000000000;
    
    static List<Integer>[] g = new ArrayList[TOTAL_NODES + 1];
    static int[][] cap = new int[TOTAL_NODES + 1][TOTAL_NODES + 1];
    static int[][] flow = new int[TOTAL_NODES + 1][TOTAL_NODES + 1];
    static int[] depth = new int[TOTAL_NODES + 1];
    static int[] prev_node = new int[TOTAL_NODES + 1];
    static int[] cursor = new int[TOTAL_NODES + 1];
    
    static {
        for (int i = 0; i <= TOTAL_NODES; i++) {
            g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }
    
    static boolean levelBfs(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(depth, -1);
        depth[s] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int v : g[u]) {
                if (cap[u][v] - flow[u][v] > 0 && depth[v] == -1) {
                    depth[v] = depth[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return depth[t] != -1;
    }
    
    static boolean dfsFlow(int u, int t) {
        if (u == t) return true;
        for (int i = cursor[u]; i < g[u].size(); i++) {
            cursor[u] = i;
            int v = g[u].get(i);
            if (depth[v] == depth[u] + 1 && cap[u][v] - flow[u][v] > 0 && dfsFlow(v, t)) {
                prev_node[v] = u;
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    static boolean findPath(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(prev_node, -1);
        prev_node[s] = 0;
        return dfsFlow(s, t);
    }
    
    static void clearFlowData() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= TOTAL_NODES; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(cap[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(flow[i], 0);
        }
    }
    
    static void addConnection(int u, int v, int capacity) {
        g[u].add(v);
        g[v].add(u);
        cap[u][v] += capacity;
    }
    
    static int dinicAlgorithm(int s, int t) {
        int flowValue = 0;
        while (levelBfs(s, t)) {
            Arrays.fill(cursor, 0);
            while (findPath(s, t)) {
                int bottleneck = MAX_VAL;
                for (int v = t, u = prev_node[v]; v != s; v = u, u = prev_node[v]) {
                    bottleneck = Math.min(bottleneck, cap[u][v] - flow[u][v]);
                }
                for (int v = t, u = prev_node[v]; v != s; v = u, u = prev_node[v]) {
                    flow[u][v] += bottleneck;
                    flow[v][u] -= bottleneck;
                }
                flowValue += bottleneck;
            }
        }
        return flowValue;
    }
    
    static int vertex(int size, int r, int c, boolean isRight) {
        return r * size + c + (isRight ? size * size : 0);
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int timeLimit = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        
        String[] lines = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            lines[i] = sc.nextLine();
        }
        
        int[] origin = new int[2];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = lines[i];
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = line.charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y') {
                    world[i][j] = 'Y';
                } else if (c == 'Z') {
                    world[i][j] = 'Z';
                    origin[0] = i;
                    origin[1] = j;
                } else {
                    world[i][j] = '.';
                    pop[i][j] += c - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = line.charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Y' && c != 'Z') {
                    help[i][j] += c - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < LIMIT; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < LIMIT; j++) {
                fire[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        fire[origin[0]][origin[1]] = 0;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(origin);
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = x + dx[k], ny = y + dy[k];
                if (0 <= nx && nx < n && 0 <= ny && ny < n && world[nx][ny] == '.' && fire[nx][ny] == -1) {
                    fire[nx][ny] = fire[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < LIMIT; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < LIMIT; j++) {
                for (int ri = 0; ri < LIMIT; ri++) {
                    for (int rj = 0; rj < LIMIT; rj++) {
                        time_to_reach[i][j][ri][rj] = -1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (world[i][j] == '.') {
                    time_to_reach[i][j][i][j] = 0;
                    Queue<int[]> bfs = new LinkedList<>();
                    bfs.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    while (!bfs.isEmpty()) {
                        int[] cell = bfs.poll();
                        int r = cell[0], c = cell[1];
                        if (fire[r][c] == -1 || time_to_reach[i][j][r][c] < fire[r][c]) {
                            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                                int nr = r + dx[k], nc = c + dy[k];
                                if (0 <= nr && nr < n && 0 <= nc && nc < n && world[nr][nc] == '.' &&
                                    (fire[nr][nc] == -1 || time_to_reach[i][j][r][c] + 1 <= fire[nr][nc]) &&
                                    time_to_reach[i][j][nr][nc] == -1) {
                                    time_to_reach[i][j][nr][nc] = time_to_reach[i][j][r][c] + 1;
                                    bfs.offer(new int[]{nr, nc});
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int source = 2 * n * n;
        int sink = 2 * n * n + 1;
        clearFlowData();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (pop[i][j] > 0) {
                    addConnection(source, vertex(n, i, j, false), pop[i][j]);
                }
                if (help[i][j] > 0) {
                    addConnection(vertex(n, i, j, true), sink, help[i][j]);
                }
                for (int ri = 0; ri < n; ri++) {
                    for (int rj = 0; rj < n; rj++) {
                        if (time_to_reach[i][j][ri][rj] != -1 && time_to_reach[i][j][ri][rj] <= timeLimit) {
                            addConnection(vertex(n, i, j, false), vertex(n, ri, rj, true), MAX_VAL);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(dinicAlgorithm(source, sink));
    }
}
